techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield
techParks.description: The KIADB Export Promotion Industrial Park in Whitefield, laid out in Phase I (around Whitefield Main Road / Hoodi) and Phase II (towards Brookefield and Kundalahalli), is a plotted industrial-cum-IT zone rather than a single campus. It hosts owner-occupied R&D campuses (SAP Labs India #138, GE's John F. Welch Technology Centre at #122, Tesco #81-82, Qualcomm #125-127, AMD #102-103, Microchip #149-B, NTT DATA #178, Capgemini #155-170, TCS Abhilash #96 and L-Centre #78-83) plus multi-tenant buildings such as Gopalan Global Axis (#152), Kalyani Platina (#6 & 24), Mindcomp Tech Park (#149-A), Whitefield Palms and Embassy Crest. The coordinate is the Photon/OSM node for 'EPIP Zone', not a polygon centroid.

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Campus
techParks.description: SAP Labs India's owner-occupied main campus at #138 EPIP Zone, Whitefield (blocks A-E plus later buildings), the company's largest R&D hub outside Germany until the second Devanahalli campus opened in August 2025. SAP also lists an RMZ NXT site in nearby Mahadevapura.

techParks.name: John F. Welch Technology Centre
aliases: GE John F. Welch Technology Centre
techParks.description: GE's first and largest integrated multidisciplinary R&D centre outside the US, inaugurated by Jack Welch on 17 September 2000 on a 50-acre campus in Whitefield's EPIP zone (plot 122). Since GE's 2024 split it is described as a GE Aerospace site (25th anniversary in 2025) while GE HealthCare still lists its X-ray division at No. 122 EPIP.

techParks.name: Brigade Tech Gardens
techParks.description: A ~3 million sq ft LEED Platinum SEZ campus on Brookefields Green Avenue, Kundalahalli (ITPL Main Road, Phase 2), developed by Brigade Enterprises with GIC and inaugurated in December 2022; six blocks in a B cluster (B1, B3) and a C cluster (C1, C2, C4, C5), with BuzzWorks coworking. Confirmed occupiers include Manhattan Associates (B1, since 2019), Aptiv's Technical Center India (237,000 sq ft, Feb 2023), JLR's technology and business services arm (~2.04 lakh sq ft) and FNF India (Butterfly building, B1).

techParks.name: Brigade Tech Park
techParks.description: A Grade A office development by Brigade on 4 acres on Whitefield Main Road at Pattandur Agrahara, next to ITPB: about 4.4 lakh sq ft over basement + ground + nine floors with 14,000-50,000 sq ft floor plates, plus a BuzzWorks managed office (750 seats, 2023). No current anchor tenant could be confirmed from a primary source.

techParks.name: Prestige Shantiniketan
techParks.description: Prestige's integrated township on Whitefield Main Road at Hoodi whose business precinct has about 3.2 million sq ft of offices in seven towers (six forming a crescent-shaped building, plus Tower C near the Nexus Shantiniketan mall). ExxonMobil's Bengaluru technology centre occupies large parts of Crescent 1 and Crescent 2 (0.531 msf renewed Nov 2023-Oct 2028) and Tata Elxsi has an office in Crescent 4.

techParks.name: Kalyani Platina
techParks.description: A multi-block office park (blocks include Block 1, Ebony and Magnolia) at Survey No 1, 6 & 24 of Kundalahalli village, EPIP Zone Phase 2, opposite Brookefield Hospital. An ICRA rationale (2016) reported 100% occupancy with the HP group taking 74% of the leased area; HP Inc, Infineon and GE HealthCare list addresses here. The coordinate is an OSM POI that carries the Kalyani Platina address, not a park polygon.

techParks.name: Gopalan Global Axis
techParks.locality: EPIP Zone Phase 2, Hoodi Village, Whitefield
techParks.description: Gopalan Enterprises' IT SEZ at Plot 152, EPIP Zone (Hoodi village, K.R. Puram Hobli), on ITPL Main Road; Square Yards gives the project as 26 acres. Oracle Financial Services Software (Units I & II), LTIMindtree (4th-7th floors) and Unisys Global Services India (Block G, 3rd-4th floors) list it as an office, and GoodWorks runs a ~42,000 sq ft managed office here.

techParks.name: Sigma Soft Tech Park
techParks.locality: Ramagondanahalli / Varthur Kodi, Whitefield Main Road
techParks.description: A four-tower IT park (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta) at No. 7 Whitefield Main Road, Ramagondanahalli / Varthur Kodi, south of Whitefield; a listing gives about 835,000 sq ft built-up. Occupiers are mostly small and mid-size firms by registry address (Embitel Technologies in Delta, ATI Accurate Technologies India in Alpha, Mercatus Commerce in Gamma), and GoodWorks runs a coworking floor.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park
techParks.developer: Salarpuria Sattva (50:50 Salarpuria and Sattva JV)
techParks.description: A ~2.4 lakh sq ft leasable office building at Plot 149-A, EPIP Phase 2, held by Mindcomp Tech Park Pvt Ltd (a 50:50 Salarpuria-Sattva JV). CRISIL reported it fully leased to three tenants (Novo Nordisk, BSH Household and Pharmed) as of May 2025; Novo Nordisk's GBS lists its office on the 4th floor.

techParks.name: DivyaSree Technopark
techParks.description: DivyaSree's IT/ITES SEZ at Sy. No. 36/2, Kundalahalli (Doddanakundi post), at the southern edge of the EPIP zone next to the Huawei campus. Wipro (SEZ Units I & II), Capgemini (blocks B4, B5, A5, A6) and Accenture list offices here. Distinct from DivyaSree Technopolis on the Old Airport Road / Yemalur side.

techParks.name: Titanium Tech Park
techParks.description: An office campus in the Kadugodi industrial belt east of ITPB. Airbus leased an entire building here (reported as 650,000 sq ft over 10 years, Dec 2024; CRE Matrix separately records a 1.51 lakh sq ft lease to Oct 2034) for the Airbus India Technology Centre inaugurated in March 2026, and an OSM POI places Caterpillar's Cat Digital office here.

techParks.name: Sumadhura Capitol Towers
techParks.locality: Kadugodi (Hope Farm Junction), Whitefield Main Road
techParks.description: Sumadhura's office-and-retail project on 8.67 acres near Hope Farm Junction with about 1.5 million sq ft leasable. In 2025 Sumadhura reported leasing ~5 lakh sq ft to First Brands Group, Terex India and Saiharmony Solutions; Swiggy moved its Bengaluru headquarters here in April 2026 (about 2,000 staff), and an OSM POI places BMW TechWorks India in Tower 2.

techParks.name: Alembic City
techParks.description: Alembic's mixed-use campus on Whitefield-Hoskote Road at Kadugodi. Google IT Services India leased about 650,000 sq ft here in October 2024 and by early 2026 held rights to about 2.4-2.6 million sq ft (Annex Tower, Office Block Towers B and G reserved for it).

techParks.name: Embassy Crest
techParks.description: Embassy's two-phase office building in EPIP Phase 1 next to Whitefield Palms. Mercedes-Benz R&D India renewed its lease here for 60 months at the end of 2023.

techParks.name: Whitefield Palms
techParks.locality: EPIP Zone Phase 1, Whitefield Main Road
techParks.description: Office campus at Plot Nos. 9 & 10, Whitefield Main Road, EPIP Phase 1, which is the registered visitor and postal address of Mercedes-Benz R&D India and of Daimler Truck Innovation Center India.

techParks.name: Bhoruka Tech Park
aliases: Bhoruka Tech Park, Mahadevapura Industrial Area
techParks.description: Office park at Sy. No. 27 & 31, Mahadevapura Industrial Area, Hoodi, on Whitefield Road. Hitachi Energy runs its India R&D centre on the 3rd floor and Tata Elxsi has an office in Block I.

techParks.name: GR Tech Park
techParks.description: Office park east of ITPB at Pattandur Agrahara (blocks include Vayu), where Awfis runs a coworking centre on the first floor of Vayu block. OSM maps SAP, HP, Sapient and TCS (Jal, Dhara, Agni) POIs inside it, but no current tenant could be confirmed from a primary source.

techParks.name: Nethra Tech Park
techParks.description: Small office building in the EPIP Industrial Area at Kundalahalli village; a business directory and an OSM POI place a Collins Aerospace office here.

techParks.name: HM Tech Park
techParks.description: Office building on Whitefield Main Road near Hope Farm, Kadugodi; Netradyne's Bengaluru engineering office is based here per its job postings.

techParks.name: Kadugodi Industrial Area
techParks.description: Older KIADB industrial estate on Whitefield Main Road at Kadugodi / Sadaramangala, home to the Wipro GE Healthcare head office and medical-device factory at No. 4 (CT, cath-lab, ultrasound, patient monitoring).

techParks.name: RMZ NXT
techParks.description: RMZ office campus at 2A/2B Sonnenahalli village on ITPL Main Road, immediately west of the SAP Labs campus; SAP Labs India lists it as its second Whitefield-side site.

techParks.name: Prestige Technostar
techParks.description: Prestige office campus on ITPL Main Road west of Kundalahalli Gate; AMD's largest global design centre (about 500,000 sq ft, ~3,000 engineers by 2028) was inaugurated here in November 2023, and The Executive Centre runs a centre here.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: Bagmane's campus on the ITPL Main Road west of Brookefield; Schneider Electric opened one of its largest employee campuses here in 2024 (capacity 8,000+), and Infineon leased its consolidated 'SILANE' campus here for up to 4,500 employees, planned for autumn 2026.

coverageNotes: Scope: Whitefield beyond ITPB itself (ITPB, its buildings and tenants such as Societe Generale (Voyager/Victor), Mu Sigma, HCL and the TCS Jal/Dhara/Agni blocks are left to the ITPL lens, except where a lens company also has an ITPB site, e.g. GE HealthCare, ExxonMobil and Applied Materials, entered with ITPB park-centroid coordinates). Web search budget ran out (shared 200-search limit) before Huawei's current status, Dell, Siemens Healthineers and some park tenant rosters could be rechecked; later checks used direct fetches of already-known official pages. NOT CONFIRMED and therefore left out: Dell (only official address found is Embassy GolfLinks, Domlur; no Whitefield/EPIP site evidenced), Honeywell, Shell (Shell Technology Centre Bangalore is in north Bengaluru near Devanahalli, not Hoodi; the OSM 'Shell' polygons in Hoodi and Brookefield are unverified), Boeing, Xerox, Sun Microsystems, Infosys, L&T Technology Services (only LTIMindtree is evidenced at Gopalan Global Axis / EPIP Plot 25-31), Lowe's (directory places it at Manyata), Bosch / BGSW (no Whitefield site found), Siemens Healthineers (new campus location not found), Societe Generale (ITPB only), Perot Systems (now NTT DATA, entered) and iGATE (now Capgemini, entered). Delphi: OSM shows 'Delphi Automotive Systems' at Kalyani Platina; Aptiv (ex-Delphi) moved to Brigade Tech Gardens in Feb 2023, and the date the old site closed is unknown, so no Kalyani Platina office is recorded for Aptiv. Manhattan Associates' old #172 EPIP site (OSM) closed in 2019 and is omitted. Lower-confidence items kept and flagged: Mercedes-Benz R&D at Brigade Tech Gardens (OSM POI and MD at the inauguration only; low), Embitel at Sigma Soft Tech Park (registry/directory only; low), Mphasis 'Mascot' at EPIP No. 80 (directories only; low, EPIP zone point), Unisys at Global Axis (Naukri contact page, possibly stale), FNF India (job postings), Accenture at DivyaSree Technopark (job postings plus OSM), Collins Aerospace Nethra Tech Park (directory plus OSM). Coordinates: EPIP Zone has no OSM polygon, so its point is the Photon/OSM 'EPIP Zone' node (12.97819, 77.72465) and offices without a plot-level POI (Applied Materials EPIP, Mphasis) use it as a park point. Kalyani Platina has no OSM polygon (the geocoder returned the DoubleTree inside Kalyani Tech Park), so its point is the OSM POI carrying a 'Kalyani Platina Tech Park, #24 EPIP Phase 2' address. Infineon's Block 1 point is an OSM POI at the '24 - Blk 1, EPIP Zone' address that OSM labels Qualcomm. BMW TechWorks' building is not named in the lease report; only an OSM POI places it in Sumadhura Capitol Towers. Status choices: Microchip's 170-172 EPIP blocks (bought Nov 2025) and ExxonMobil's ITPB Inventor lease (July 2026) are 'planned' because occupation is not reported; Infineon Kalyani Platina is 'closing' and its SILANE campus at Bagmane Solarium 'planned' (operational start scheduled for autumn 2026, not confirmed). Swiggy's former Bellandur HQ (vacated April 2026) is not recorded because its exact building was not verified. Other leads seen in OSM but not verified and omitted: Tata Communications, Airtel Nxtra and ST Telemedia data centres in EPIP; Infinite Computer Solutions (157 EPIP); Vidal Health; Rossell Techsys (the company places its plant in Devanahalli); Sasmos HET; Harman; IHS Markit / S&P Global and Tesco at SJR iPark; Google Connect Services and Hindustan Unilever POIs in Prestige Shantiniketan (Wikipedia's unsourced Shantiniketan tenant list was not used as evidence); Airbus Group India at Mahadevapura; NetApp at Hoodi; the Bagmane Solarium tenants (Baker Hughes, Cognizant, Tekion, Carelon, Northern Trust, Thermo Fisher, SAP Fioneer), left to the Bagmane lens. Parks with no confirmed anchor tenant (Brigade Tech Park, GR Tech Park) are listed with empty tenant arrays; Sigma Soft Tech Park's occupiers are mostly small firms known only from registry addresses (ATI Accurate Technologies, Mercatus Commerce, Simerics, Mothercare Sourcing India). Out-of-lens offices of in-lens companies that were evidenced on official pages but not geocoded and so omitted: Capgemini (Pritech Park 6B, RMZ Ecoworld 5B, Prestige Tech Park Vector, Global Village), HP (Embassy Prime, Pritech Park, Electronic City), Oracle (Bellandur Tech Hub, Embassy Business Park), Hitachi Energy (Brigade Opus and Godrej Centre in Hebbal, Peenya factory), Qualcomm (Bagmane Constellation / Capital leases), Terex (E.City Tower 2, Bommasandra R&D), Unisys (Sarjapur Road). Headcounts are given only where a source states a Bengaluru figure (Aptiv 2,000+ in 2023; Novo Nordisk GBS 4,500 in 2025).
